predecessors.name: Sultanate of Rum
predecessors.text: the Kastamonu country held by the Chobanids

successors.name: Beylik of Candar (Isfendiyarids)
successors.text: the Kastamonu country conquered by Süleyman I Candar, who made it his seat

ledger.x: 1211: Husam al-Din Choban founds the Chobanid beylik at Kastamonu.
1309: the Candar state, until then at Eflani, takes Kastamonu from the Chobanids and makes it its seat.
1309: the Chobanid beylik at Kastamonu ends (beyliks table 1211-1309); its land passes to the Candars of Eflani.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary of the Chobanid beylik; the whole life is the Cliopatria 1305 shape, approximate, and its limits towards Sinop and the Candar core at Eflani are not sourced.
